text:
Maya: Quick PSA — we bolted a MoonBoard on the 6th-floor terrace this morning. Please read the two rules before climbing: 1) leash the door, 2) wipe holds after use. No solo dynos if nobody else around. :boulder:

Jon: yesss. this is going to ruin productivity in the best way. when's a good intro session?

Soph: I can run a 20-min primer tonight at 6:15pm for folks who haven't used one before. short safety + route reading tips. sign-up below?

Kevin: i'll bring a crash pad and a small chalk bucket. can someone bring tape for skin?

Anita: added a quick signup — please add name + time slot: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EXAMPLE

Maya: thx! also please don't wear office shoes on the plywood platform (it's slightly grippier than it looks).

ops-bot: Safety reminder — terrace door must remain unlocked from inside while climbing. If you trip the fire alarm while climbing, Facilities will not be amused.

Soph: schedule snippet in case folks want to copy:
```
Thu 18:15 - intro & safety (20m)
Thu 18:40 - open jam (60m)
Fri 07:00 - hangboard primer (15m)
```

Jon: i'm down for the open jam. putting my name in for 18:40.

Kevin: added — bringing tape + pad. also +1 for chalk bucket (but please use w/ brush on holds).

Anita: poll: structured 20-min intro followed by open jam or free jam from the start? react with :one: for structured, :two: for free

Jon: :two:

Maya: :one: (we should teach proper falling technique; saw a near-shoulder roll last week)

Soph: good point. we'll do structured intro the first session and then rotate leaders for future sessions.

Kevin: FYI — if anyone wants a quick grip test, bring gloves. i'll have a small tape kit by the pad.

Anita: awesome. parking the sheet and I'll post a reminder at 17:30. please respect the terrace plants and wipe chalk off the railings. :seedling: 

Maya: also — tiny etiquette note: if you leave the terrace, lock the glass door gently, don't slam. thanks everyone :heart:
